item.description:
A night sky for Breathe. The session opens on the plain midnight ground and a field of stars rises as it settles, standing whole with time left to rest under them. The screen also runs glass-smooth now, at your display's full refresh rate.

Clean learns two repairs, both proven on real dictation. A sentence the engine split at a pause and carried on in lowercase is rejoined; a phrase said twice in a row is said once.

Your words stay yours. A polish can no longer turn a task you handed to someone else ("you should sort it") into one you took on yourself ("I should sort it").
